name: 柔弯杏目
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE new female facial-feature combination in our existing game's APPROVED current illustration style, part of a three-option extension.

SOLE IMAGE REFERENCE: the supplied female_active.png is the VERIFIED ACTUAL current game portrait. Its style, warm ivory skin, restrained eyes/nose/lips, subtle color and contrast, hair and complete waist-up proportions are the authority. A previous closely matched calibration was approved; now extend the facial parts while STAYING in this exact rendering.

Preserve this image's full 1024x1536 portrait layout from the hairpin/hair top to below the waist sash. Keep the SAME underlying oval FACE OUTLINE, ears, neck, head/shoulder proportions, bone structure, skin color, half-up wooden-pin hair, gray charcoal-black matte hair strands, complete blue-gray/ivory floral/cloud robe, sleeve pose, pattern style, sash and pale neutral warm-gray ivory backdrop. Do not enlarge the head or zoom into a beauty portrait.

Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes, nose and mouth into the specific coherent new combination below. Make the geometric differences visibly readable as an attractive new option; do not copy the reference's existing four facial parts unchanged. Shape differences must remain mild, natural and compatible with this SAME base face. Every new feature should look painted by the source illustrator, not cut from a different game or a glossy digital beauty painting.

Preserve SOURCE visual handwriting: soft thin locally faded eye edges, fine sparse brow hairs, short restrained eyelashes, normal original iris proportion naturally covered by upper lid, muted brown iris, very small quiet highlights. Skin pale warm ivory with shallow neutral softly modeled volume; original light variations and subtle texture, NO whole-face pink wash, uniform blush or beauty-filter smoothing. The nose has a complete subtle root, bridge, tip, alae and nostrils using local very faint muted shading. Mouth natural low-saturation peach-beige and softly relaxed, closed without a new strong expression, restrained cupid's bow and quiet local highlights.

Maintain a softly attractive adult feminine overall face. Do not exaggerate a component just to show difference; avoid tired slit eyes, heavy straight eyebrows, big round doll eyes, broad hard nose, conspicuous nostrils, inflated lips, flat long dark mouth line, duck lips or pointy V chin. The face outline, complexion and scale stay the same; only feature construction varies.

Hair remains the source's GREY CHARCOAL-BLACK with low warm-gray highlights, matte fine flowing strands; do NOT make brown, glossy, darker and sculpted. Clothing remains gently textured and quiet, not repainted in a new art style. No diagram, comparison panels, lettering or watermark. One woman only, same complete half-body portrait on the same plain background.

Specific NEW facial-part combination: Eyebrows are distinctly fine LONG SOFTLY CURVED brows with a low smooth arch, finer and more curved than the reference's flatter brows, gently tapered tails, light sparse natural hairs. Eyes are soft relaxed ALMOND eyes, with a smooth rounded central LOWER-LID ARC and level outer corners; upper-lid curve comfortable and open, natural original iris scale. This combination is gently flowing, not excited or sleepy. Nose is delicately SOFT ROUND-TIPPED with a short-to-medium light bridge, smooth modest round alae and faint complete nostrils, no extra white reflection. Lips are softly NEAT SHALLOW-BOW lips of modest natural width, very gentle low cupid peak, fine upper lip and lightly rounded lower lip; corners relaxed level. Attractive gentle adult features, mild but clear curvature differences.
